5 Bedroom House in Port Owen

40 admiral island, 40 admiral island boulevard, port owen, velddrif 40 admiral island boulevard
5 4 5 923 m²

Modern home with shared jetty rights,

Please click on the photo''s to open,

Situated on a North front corner plot, this home also comes with shared jetty rights - a valuable feature.

This beautiful home on sought after Admiral island welcomes you with light, space and calm. The main house is bright and airy, with open trusses and large windows that allow natural light to flood in. As you enter you immediately notice the enclosed courtyard, a lovely feature that bring the outdoors into the home.

The modern kitchen offers clean lines, quality finishes, and stylish lightning, with a separate scullery for added convenience. From the kitchen, a passage leads to a versatile room that can be used as a study, studio or extra bedroom. It includes its own modern en suite bathroom. The kitchen also opens onto the wind-free courtyard - perfect for entertaining, relaxing.

The living area features a gas fireplace. The South facing guest bedroom is a real wow - with its own en suite bathroom. The main bedroom is modern with lots of cupboards as well as a walk in dressing room and a full en suite bathroom.

Between the main house and the 2 bedroom cottage are three garages - the double garage with direct access as well as access to the third garage.

The spacious two bedroom cottage is completely private offering open plan living and 1 bathroom. Ideal for visiting family or extended stays.

Also has a solar system for the main house.

Offers style space and a wonderful ambiance, Don''t miss this one!!
